info.title: RunSignal CLI: provision alerts for background jobs from a workload manifest
info.description: The runsignal command: plan, diff and provision New Relic alerts, or export Prometheus alerting rules (missed, overrun, stalled, low-output and failure-rate), for the background jobs listed in RunSignal workload manifests. Also runs scripts and Kubernetes CronJobs as monitored workloads (runsignal exec) and writes manifests from CronJobs (runsignal discover kubernetes). Idempotent and safe to run in CI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: RunSignal: alerts for background work that no HTTP status code describes.

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Run a command as one run of a workload and export it over OTLP: success on exit code 0, failure otherwise, cancelled when stopped by a signal. Configure the exporter with the standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* variables. Returns the command's exit code.

options.name: --workload
options.description: The workload this command is a run of, such as nightly-invoice. It must match the manifest.

options.name: --service
options.description: The service.name to report as, matching the manifest's service. Defaults to OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.

options.name: --temporality
options.description: delta (required by New Relic) or cumulative (Prometheus). Defaults to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE, then cumulative.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: The command and its arguments, after --.

commands.name: discover
commands.description: Write a workload manifest from where jobs are scheduled, for jobs that report through runsignal exec.

commands.name: kubernetes
commands.description: Write a manifest from Kubernetes CronJobs whose containers run their command through runsignal exec. Schedules, time zones and activeDeadlineSeconds come from the CronJobs; runsignal.io/* annotations set the rest.

options.name: --service
options.description: The service.name the jobs report as (runsignal exec --service, or OTEL_SERVICE_NAME).

options.name: --input
options.description: Read CronJobs from this file (kubectl get cronjobs -o json), or - for standard input, instead of running kubectl.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The namespace to read CronJobs from. Defaults to kubectl's current namespace.

options.name: --all-namespaces
options.description: Read CronJobs from every namespace. [default: False]

options.name: --context
options.description: The kubeconfig context to use.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the manifest to this file instead of standard output.
